errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line (Accuracy) drops to a value at Answer Popularity = 20, but the data point for this dip is at Answer Popularity = 25.
The description states that the green line (Confidence) drops to a value at Answer Popularity = 20, but the data point for this dip is at Answer Popularity = 25.
The description states that the red line (Alignment) drops to a value at Answer Popularity = 20, but the data point for this dip is at Answer Popularity = 25.
The peak value of 0.89 for the red line (Alignment) is reached at Answer Popularity = 95, not 100. At 100, the value is slightly lower.

errors.text_span: representing normalized performance or perception scores
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled only as "Values." The description adds an interpretation that these are "normalized performance or perception scores," which is not explicitly stated in the figure.
The dip in the blue "Accuracy" line occurs at an x-value of approximately 25, not at the tick mark of 20.
The steep rise in the "Accuracy" line reaches a value of approximately 0.82 at an x-value of 45, not 0.8 at 40.
The "Accuracy" line does not gradually increase to the end. It peaks around an x-value of 95 (at ~0.88) and ends at approximately 0.83 at an x-value of 155. The final value is not 0.85.
The dip in the red "Alignment" line occurs at an x-value of approximately 25, not 20.
The sharp climb in the "Alignment" line reaches a value of approximately 0.81 at an x-value of 45, not 0.83 at 40.
The "Alignment" line does not plateau in this range; it actually decreases from approximately 0.86 (at x=55) to 0.82 (at x=75). The value range is also inaccurate.

errors.text_span: The plot suggests that as answer popularity increases, all three metrics generally improve or stabilize at high levels, with Confidence remaining consistently high and Accuracy and Alignment showing more pronounced growth after an initial dip.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides a summary and interpretation of the trends shown in the plot, which goes beyond a direct description of the visual data.
